prompt: As of August 1, 2024, are there any cities in England that are more populated than Philadelphia, and which cities are they?
answer:
Yes. Using comparable **urban-area populations** (latest figures available around August 1, 2024), four English cities were more populous than Philadelphia, whose population was approximately **1.55 million**:

| City | Approx. population |
|---|---:|
| London | 10.9 million |
| Manchester | 2.86 million |
| Birmingham | 2.69 million |
| Leeds | 1.93 million |

The next largest, Liverpool, was about **927,000**, so it was below Philadelphia.

These figures use broader built-up/urban-area boundaries. On a strict **local-authority or city-council** basis, the comparison changes substantially: Birmingham, Manchester and Leeds each have populations below Philadelphia, while London’s wider Greater London population remains much higher.
